name: Casino & Gacha
description: Chance games, built to be auditable. The pack carries one hard rule in the contracts themselves rather than in a policy document: VIRTUAL CURRENCY ONLY -- no real-money wagering, no cash-out, and no component here has any concept of a payment method. Everything else follows from disclosure. utility.probability_core publishes its rates and refuses a table whose weights contradict them rather than silently normalising; economy.pity_system makes the safety net an output the player can read; and presentation.slot_reel_resolver decides the outcome BEFORE the reels spin, so the animation is theatre that admits it is theatre. Duplicates convert automatically, because a collection game that lets copies pile up unconverted has wasted the pulls that produced them.
loop: earn/pull → reveal → convert duplicates → pity builds → banner rotates

signatureCompound.name: Eighty-Nine Pulls and the Ninetieth
signatureCompound.description: The disclosure chain doing its job: gacha_banner counts pulls since featured and shows the number, pity_system raises the effective rate through soft pity and guarantees the featured outcome at ninety, probability_core takes each draw from a seeded stream and logs it against the boosted rate actually used, and duplicate_converter turns the copies that arrive along the way into shards. Every step is readable by the player, which is the only defensible way to ship this genre.
